title: Alerting on Cloud Connector health: event and metrics feeds and console checks

prose.text: Connector health reaches an operator through streamed records or through checks run in the console. This subject sets out both and what is still open.

prose.label: Through a SIEM.
prose.text: {{siem-alerting-path}} Whether the console can notify by email or webhook is open {{gap:native-notifications}}, and so is whether alerts travel over Log and Control Forwarding {{gap:alerts-via-lc}}.

prose.label: Console checks.
prose.text: {{connectivity-checks}} The checks for seeing connector traffic in ZIA and ZPA are in [[cloud-connector.logs]].

prose.label: Other tools.
prose.text: Whether connector VMs can be polled with SNMP is open {{gap:snmp}}. Whether ZDX reports anything about Cloud Connectors is open {{gap:zdx}}. Cloud-provider health alarms on the load balancer belong to the deployment, in [[cloud-connector.overview.load-balancing]].

checks.do: Whether the tenant has an Event feed to its SIEM, without which connector state changes leave no streamed record.
Whether session logs show the connector's own self-traffic and Tunnel Insights shows traffic, when connectivity to Internet & SaaS is in doubt.

siem-alerting-path.statement: Alerting on connector state runs through a SIEM: Event logs are written on status changes of health checks, tunnels and upgrades and Metrics logs on resource usage, both streamed by NSS feeds, while the captured monitoring pages are refreshed manually.
siem-alerting-path.conditions: Chain of evidence from the event and metrics feed articles and the monitoring page; it rests on no captured article describing a console notification, which is not proof that none exists.

connectivity-checks.statement: The Azure and AWS troubleshooting checks for connectivity to Internet & SaaS are that the Internet Access Gateway is populated in the Admin Console, session logs display the Cloud Connector self-traffic, and tunnel insights are displayed.

native-notifications.title: Whether the console notifies on connector state changes
native-notifications.blocks: choosing between a SIEM-built alert and a console notification for a connector going Inactive
native-notifications.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "No dedicated Cloud Connector alerting mechanism (email, SNMP trap, PagerDuty webhook) was found in the captured CBC documentation." No captured article describes one; absence in the captures is not confirmation.

snmp.title: Whether connector VMs can be monitored with SNMP
snmp.blocks: integrating connectors into an SNMP-based network monitoring system
snmp.detail: No captured Cloud & Branch Connector article mentions SNMP for connector VMs. The NSS Servers page offers MIB files for download, which concerns NSS servers, not connectors.

zdx.title: Whether ZDX reports Cloud Connector health or performance
zdx.blocks: choosing a monitoring toolchain for connectors
zdx.detail: Unverified legacy statement: ZDX's "relevance to Cloud Connector (a server-side proxy) is Tier D — unconfirmed in captured sources". No captured source links ZDX to Cloud Connector metrics.

alerts-via-lc.title: Whether connector alerts travel over Log and Control Forwarding
alerts-via-lc.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "Alert delivery for Cloud Connector events appears to flow through Log & Control Forwarding (the CC-side operational message channel) rather than a pull-model alerting API", and disruption of that channel is "itself a health signal visible in the ZTW admin console if the CC goes Inactive". The Log and Control Forwarding help names enrollment, policy changes, software updates and logs, not alerts; no source ties Inactive to that channel.
alerts-via-lc.blocks: deciding whether a broken Log and Control path also silences connector alerts
